questionEnglish: Which of the following is a biodegradable waste material?
questionOdia: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଏକ ଜୈବ-ନିମ୍ନୀକରଣ ଯୋଗ୍ୟ (Biodegradable) ବର୍ଜ୍ୟବସ୍ତୁ?
explanation: Organic matter like fruit and vegetable peels can be broken down into simpler substances by the action of microorganisms like bacteria and fungi.

questionEnglish: What are the organisms that feed on dead and decaying matter to break them down called?
questionOdia: ମୃତ ଓ କ୍ଷୟପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ପଦାର୍ଥକୁ ଆହାର କରି ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଅପଘଟନ କରୁଥିବା ଜୀବମାନଙ୍କୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Decomposers (ଅପଘଟକ), such as bacteria and fungi, break down complex organic matter from dead organisms into simple inorganic nutrients, recycling them into the soil.

questionEnglish: According to the 10% law of energy transfer in a food chain, how much energy is passed to the next trophic level?
questionOdia: ଏକ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳରେ ଶକ୍ତି ପ୍ରବାହର ୧୦ ପ୍ରତିଶତ ନିୟମ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ପୋଷୀ ସ୍ତରକୁ କେତେ ପରିମାଣର ଶକ୍ତି ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ?
explanation: Lindeman's 10% Law states that only 10% of the organic matter stored as energy at one trophic level is transferred to the next higher level; the rest is lost as heat during respiration and metabolic processes.

questionEnglish: The progressive accumulation of non-biodegradable chemicals like pesticides at each higher trophic level is called?
questionOdia: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଉଚ୍ଚ ପୋଷୀ ସ୍ତରରେ କୀଟନାଶକ ଭଳି ଜୈବ-ଅନିମ୍ନୀକରଣ ଯୋଗ୍ୟ ରାସାୟନିକ ପଦାର୍ଥର ପରିମାଣ କ୍ରମାଗତ ଭାବେ ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇବା ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Biomagnification (ଜୈବ ପରିବର୍ଦ୍ଧନ) occurs because toxic chemicals cannot be metabolized or excreted by organisms, leading to maximum concentration at the topmost trophic level (like humans or eagles).

questionEnglish: Which chemical is mainly responsible for the depletion of the protective Ozone layer in the atmosphere?
questionOdia: ବାୟୁମଣ୍ଡଳରେ ଥିବା ସୁରକ୍ଷାକାରୀ ଓଜୋନ୍ ସ୍ତରର ଅବକ୍ଷୟ ପାଇଁ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ କେଉଁ ରାସାୟନିକ ପଦାର୍ଥ ଦାୟୀ?
explanation: Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) used in refrigeration and fire extinguishers release chlorine atoms when exposed to UV light, which break down ozone (O3) molecules into oxygen.

questionEnglish: An ecosystem consists of which of the following components?
questionOdia: ଏକ ପାରିସଂସ୍ଥା (Ecosystem) ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ କେଉଁ ଉପାଦାନଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ନେଇ ଗଠିତ?
explanation: An ecosystem includes all living organisms (biotic components like plants, animals, microbes) interacting with their physical environment (abiotic components like soil, water, air, sunlight).

questionEnglish: Which trophic level do green plants occupy in any food chain?
questionOdia: କୌଣସି ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳରେ ସବୁଜ ଉଦ୍ଭିଦଗୁଡ଼ିକ କେଉଁ ପୋଷୀ ସ୍ତର (Trophic Level) ଗ୍ରହଣ କରନ୍ତି?
explanation: Green plants are autotrophs or producers (ଉତ୍ପାଦକ) that fix solar energy into chemical energy, forming the foundation or first trophic level of an ecosystem.

questionEnglish: A network of interconnected food chains operating in an ecosystem is known as?
questionOdia: ଏକ ପାରିସଂସ୍ଥାରେ ପରସ୍ପର ସହିତ ସଂଯୁକ୍ତ ହୋଇ ରହିଥିବା ଅନେକଗୁଡ଼ିଏ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳର ଜାଲକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: A food web (ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଜାଲ) represents the complex, real-world feeding relationships in an ecosystem, showing that one organism can be consumed by multiple types of organisms.

questionEnglish: What is the molecular formula of Ozone, which shields the Earth from harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation?
questionOdia: ପୃଥିବୀକୁ କ୍ଷତିକାରକ ଅତିବାଇଗଣି ରଶ୍ମିରୁ ରକ୍ଷା କରୁଥିବା ଓଜୋନ୍ ଗ୍ୟାସ୍‌ର ଆଣବିକ ସଙ୍କେତ କଣ?
explanation: Ozone is a triatomic molecule made of three oxygen atoms (O3). It forms a protective layer in the stratosphere that absorbs deadly UV-B and UV-C rays.

questionEnglish: In an ecological pyramid of numbers or energy, which level is always placed at the broad base?
questionOdia: ଏକ ପାରିସଂସ୍ଥା ପିରାମିଡ୍‌ର ଚଉଡ଼ା ଆଧାର ବା ତଳ ଭାଗରେ ସଦାସର୍ବଦା କାହାକୁ ରଖାଯାଏ?
explanation: Producers are placed at the base of ecological pyramids because they have the highest numerical count and possess the maximum trapped energy inside any stable ecosystem.
